experiences.title: Software Engineer
description: Build and maintain C# services for identity, authorization, and user provisioning.

Reworked an API Gateway request path that passed through four layers before making an HTTP call. The new ApiService pattern makes routes shorter, easier to test, and easier to trace; it also limits SSRF risk by keeping service names typed and endpoints in configuration.
Moved Identity CRUD operations from tenant IDs to company IDs behind a feature flag, allowing the architecture to change without disrupting existing consumers.
Helped restore our email sender reputation, then built a privacy-conscious Grafana dashboard for bounce, spam, and failure rates so the problem would not become invisible again.
Set practical alert thresholds in Terraform, including removing noise that could otherwise wake someone at 3 a.m.
Write technical documentation for migrations and share useful tools with the team, including a live demo of a Lucidchart MCP workflow.

experiences.title: Platform Engineer
description: Slashed observability costs by cutting Datadog log ingestion expenses by over 100% of my own salary in my first month, through retention policy tuning, exclusion filters, and fine-grained control over high-volume sources.
Built advanced Datadog dashboards with custom widgets, monitors, and composite alerts tailored to engineering and business KPIs — improving incident response and reducing alert fatigue.
Instrumented services with Datadog APM and logs across multiple environments, enabling better trace visibility and root cause analysis.
Streamlined AWS billing architecture using Terraform to deploy org-wide cost monitoring, account tagging strategies, and consolidated billing views across multiple accounts and environments.
Managed IaC with Terraform, implementing reusable modules for AWS services (VPC, IAM, EC2, S3, billing), and standardizing infrastructure provisioning workflows.
Enhanced endpoint security by automating MacBook encryption and configuration via Jamf, integrating it into onboarding processes for better compliance and auditability.
Contributed to AWS data migration, assisting in storage and access control setup for billing data for all accounts.
Assisted SIEM configuration, supporting log source integration and pipeline validation across cloud and SaaS providers.
Automated Snyk vulnerability reporting, sending weekly API-based reports to Google Sheets with charts for issue tracking and trend analysis, enhancing visibility for the security team.
